envelope.description: Trace and correct measured admission latency

body.title: Trace and correct measured admission latency
body.summary: Instrument public admission request, registration, stored guard/scope checks, worker startup, checkpoint/runtime binding, activation and acknowledgement; correct only the measured slow path while preserving durable acknowledgement.
acceptanceChecks: Record cold/warm monotonic segment timings and causal attribution for the observed2831ms baseline; no assumed Git/model bottleneck.

Source/projection/history qualification stays in dedicated registered background workers; any moved expensive pre-ack derivation retains equivalent current owner/author/route/guard validation and bounded DTOs.

Acknowledgement follows proven durable input/runtime activation; no provisional success, skipped checks, duplicate dispatch or detached work. Controlled two-review admit/cancel<=2s and progress-gap<=2s with failure/cancel races verified.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Measured admission segment attribution and durable-ack two-session race matrix: controlled admit/cancel<=2s, progress gap<=2s, complete owner/guard/binding checks and no duplicate dispatch.
